excluded_vuln_classes: account:read_write API key upgrade to higher privilege -- intended behavior
Content spoofing/text injection without demonstrated HTML/CSS modification
Customer creds found on darknet/forums not caused by Deribit
Employee API keys that only work on test env (production ones ARE in scope)
critical_constraint: TESTING DIRECTLY ON www.deribit.com MAKES YOU INELIGIBLE FOR BOUNTY AND DISALLOWED FROM FURTHER HUNTING -- far more severe than a typical N/A. All active testing MUST happen on test.deribit.com. Live production (*.deribit.com generally) is only in scope for wallet & balance functionality specifically -- everything else must be validated on test first, then explicit authorization requested via an open ticket before touching live.
policy_notes: Conservative approach adopted for this hunt given the severity of the live-testing penalty: passive DNS-only enumeration (subfinder, cert-transparency) is fine across *.deribit.com since it doesn't touch Deribit's own infrastructure. Active HTTP probing (httpx, any request that hits their servers) is restricted to test.deribit.com + the 2 named exact URLs (insights.deribit.com, pb.deribit.com) only. No takeover scanning across the general wildcard.
Outdated-component reports need a CVE-age waiting period before eligible (24h-30d depending on tier/severity) -- not directly actionable for a one-off recon pass, noted for awareness.
Public program, no confidentiality/private-program clause beyond standard responsible-disclosure ask.

Mobile apps in scope (Google Play com.deribit, App Store 1293674041) -- static APK analysis (Huawei AppGallery download method that worked for Banco Plata) could be attempted if useful, no account/device needed for static-only pass.
